source: make a game where you have to find hedgehogs make it so that you walk around, do obbys, and add a candy biome, a mountain biome, and a underwater biome there are 234

image_prompt.text: Walkable trails threading between the candy, mountain, and underwater areas so the player can wander between them
Hidden nooks behind candy formations, rock overhangs, and coral where hedgehogs can be tucked out of sight
A board where the hedgehogs found so far are posted
Chains of jumpable platforms forming obby sections inside each biome
Long horizontal jumps and stepped vertical platforms along the obby sections
A candy biome built from oversized sweets
A mountain biome of rock, cliffs, and high ground
An underwater biome the player moves through below the surface

layout_placement.text: Hedgehogs hidden across all three biomes as the objective items to find
Tracks which hedgehogs the player has already found
A swimmable water volume covering the underwater biome

notes: Adventure is dominant and owns the shape and preset; Obby contributed path-track and obstacle-jump as options only, which is what pulls P6 in.
Three named biomes have no option to carry them - they are free-text image entries with no marked extents or borders.
The count 234 is attached to no option; it is assumed to mean hedgehogs.

open_questions.ask: Does 234 mean there are 234 hedgehogs to find, or is it something else?
Should the three biomes sit on one connected map you can walk between, or be separate places?

theme: Stylized / Toon, split three ways - candy, alpine rock, and underwater

coverage_missing.ask: Is 234 the number of hedgehogs? And does finding them all end the game?
How large should each biome be relative to the others?
Should the whole map be cartoon-bright, or should the mountain and underwater areas be more realistic than the candy one?

answers.ask: Does 234 mean there are 234 hedgehogs to find, or is it something else?
Should the three biomes sit on one connected map you can walk between, or be separate places?
answers.answer: Put the candy, mountain, and underwater biomes on one connected map that players can walk between.
